parole.significato: rock, a stack formed by abrasion, that is created by rocks eroding and thus only the core of limestone remains.
parole.testo: From Gutnish rauk, from Old Norse hraukr (“lone high rock”), from Proto-Germanic *hraukaz (“pile (of stones); heap”).

parole.significato: precipitation that occurs at the time in spring when the starlings return; by extension: precipitation in March
parole.testo: Compound of stare (“starling”) + ur (“prominent precipitation”), roughly “starling precipitation”, from Gutnish starur, possibly from an older Old Gutnish *starur.
